label.purpose: Uppercase coral card headers, no background/border.

body.purpose: All functional text: titles, buttons, inputs, meta.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: The one shadow in the system, on note cards only.

motion.name: stamp-hover
motion.purpose: Primary stamp fills solid coral on hover.

components.name: Primary Stamp Button
components.description: The single call-to-action per card (e.g. "출근 시작하기").
components.css: .ds-stamp-primary { border: 2px solid #C9634A; color: #C9634A; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; padding: 10px 28px; transform: rotate(-1deg); transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stamp-primary:hover { background: #C9634A; color: #FFFDF8; } .ds-stamp-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1F2A44; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Stamp Button
components.css: .ds-stamp-secondary { border: 1.5px solid #B9AC8C; color: #5B5340; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; padding: 10px 22px; transition: background-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stamp-secondary:hover { background: #F1EADA; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Text/URL/delay fields — a mark on paper, not a filled pill.
components.css: .ds-underline-input { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #B9AC8C; padding: 8px 4px; font-weight: 600; color: #1F2A44; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-underline-input::placeholder { color: #A79C7F; } .ds-underline-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #C9634A; }

components.name: Type Tab
components.description: 웹사이트/프로그램 task-type switch — plain text tabs, not a segmented pill.
components.css: .ds-type-tab { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #B9AC8C; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 4px 2px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-type-tab.active { color: #C9634A; border-bottom-color: #C9634A; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Auto-start-on-login control — the one pill kept in the system.
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 40px; height: 22px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #C9634A; position: relative; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #C9634A; position: absolute; top: 2px; transition: left 0.2s; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: A single routine item — a checklist line, not a card.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 4px; border-bottom: 1.5px dashed #D8CBAE; } .ds-row-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(201,99,74,0.1); color: #C9634A; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-row-title { font-weight: 700; color: #1F2A44; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', sans-serif; margin: 0; } .ds-row-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #A79C7F; margin: 2px 0 0; }

components.name: Note Card
components.description: The page's one card surface — hosts every section (settings, form, list).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFDF8; border: 1.5px dashed #D8CBAE; border-radius: 24px; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(31,42,68,0.08); } .ds-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #C9634A; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: DeskReady reads as a page torn from a personal paper planner, not a piece of software chrome. A solid ink-navy band opens each screen like a notebook's cover strip; everything below sits on faintly ruled cream paper inside dashed-border note cards, as if hand-organized the night before. The one accent — a warm coral "stamp" — marks the single action that matters on a given card, echoing a rubber stamp or a felt-tip check mark rather than a UI button. The system replaces the product's earlier "Jinjja Seoul" teal-and-pill identity outright; that look is retired and should not be reintroduced or blended with this one.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, not glass: dashed borders and ruled-line texture stand in for shadows and gradients
One handwritten voice (Caveat) reserved for the "DeskReady" wordmark only; everything else reads in the product's existing Korean-first sans (Pretendard) at a confident bold weight
A single warm accent (coral) does double duty as ink color and the only "stamped" fill
Controls behave like marks on paper — underlines, ticks, and stamps — not glossy pill chrome

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Coral fill (not just coral text) appears on at most one button per card — the primary action. Everything else stays an outline or plain text.

rules.name: The Handwriting Is Singular Rule
rules.body: Caveat renders exactly one string on screen at a time (the wordmark). A second handwritten element would turn a signature into a costume.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Glass Rule
rules.body: Reach for a dashed border or a ruled line before reaching for a shadow or gradient. Shadows are for the page-level card only.

dos: Do keep coral fill to one stamp button per card; everything else stays outline or text.
Do use dashed borders and ruled-line texture as the system's primary depth cue.
Do keep Caveat to the single "DeskReady" wordmark.
Do style form controls as marks on paper (underlines, stamps, ticks), not glossy chrome.
donts: Don't reintroduce the retired teal (#0082B2) / bright-orange (#E54D26) pill system — it is fully replaced, not a fallback.
Don't add card shadows or hover-lift to individual task rows; the list card carries the one shadow in the system.
Don't use a second handwritten or display font anywhere else on the page.
Don't round buttons into pills; stamps are rectangular with a small radius.
